notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Eternal Witness.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
